get_modified_files: get modified .py files under specified directories since the fork point with main
summarize_modified_files: summarize which directories contain modified Python files since the last merge base
build_modified_file_list: build a list of modified .py files filtered by target subdirectories
test_modified_files_regex: test the regex pattern matching for modified Python files in specified directories
review_fork_point_detection: review how the script detects the fork point using git merge-base
